scenes.say: The first $100K is brutal. The next ones are almost lazy.
At the start, every dollar comes from your sweat. Interest is a rounding error.
The first hundred thousand takes {a_t1} years.
Because now your money is working a second shift next to you.
scenes.show: Your money works a second shift.

scenes.say: The slow part is where most people quit. It's also the only part that matters.
